query: HarborLine Co accounts payable supplier portal API invoice status procurement
answer: No public machine-access documentation was found for HarborLine's AP process. Mid-market AP desks often require a phone or email inquiry when no supplier portal or API is published.

results.title: AP inquiry practices for suppliers without a portal
results.content: Bank statements record settled cash only. Unpaid invoices and procurement holds will not appear as credits until settlement. Operational status must be obtained from the counterparty.
